source.rationale: The MISS-LANE TWIN of compile-current-state/exec-13868196: a picked customer carries its debtor code as canonical_code, so resolve-entity is sent (and echoes) `300-D059` while the parser raw is the company name. On a delivery-order miss the search-scope header (_axisWords path 1) quotes that token through _rawOfTok - whose _byRawStripped map was keyed on each entity's RAW only, so the debtor code fell through and would have printed `Customer: 300-D059` in customer copy, the exact leak live exec 13868196 shipped on the answer lane. The map is now keyed under BOTH raw and canonical_code (first-wins, raw first, same normalization), so the header reads the customer's own name. Reasoned expectations, decided before the body ran: (1) the header opens `Customer: DELUXE HOME CENTRE SDN BHD (SETAPAK)` - the entity raw, never 300-D059; (2) the found-bullet names the resolved customer; (3) the not-found line quotes the product raw `"SRTXX-9999"` (dash intact), not the resolver echo SRTXX9999; (4) NO string matching /\b300-D\d+\b/ appears anywhere in escalate_message. The run confirmed all four.
